stemMd: A line perpendicular to $3x-4y=12$ passes through $(6,1)$. Which equation represents it?
explanationMd: The original slope is 3/4, so a perpendicular slope is −4/3. Substitute (6,1): 1=−8+b, hence b=9. The slopes multiply to −1.

distractorRationale.a: The reciprocal slope needs the opposite sign.
distractorRationale.c: This negates the slope without taking its reciprocal.
distractorRationale.b: This has the same slope as the original line.
